method: Same added test and benchmark harness, toolchain and host; only the two production hash files differ between measured versions. Five 500-ms samples per operation, CPU parallelism 1, ordinary non-race builds, no competing tests or builds. Repeated retained-state reads normally use filesystem caching. Hardware identity is omitted.
source_fingerprint_scope: go.mod, go.sum, and Go/JSON/module files recursively under cmd, internal and tools. Relative paths and contents are length-prefixed with uint64BE in lexical path order. Docs and CI configuration are outside this scope.

limitations: Local repeated warm-file measurements; no timing thresholds or portable latency claim.
Allocation volume per operation is not peak heap or resident memory.
No network throughput, canonicality, activation or finality claim.
